rewrites.//: Single-page app: every unmatched path must return index.html so react-router can resolve it client-side. Without this, a hard refresh on /settings or a shared deep link returns a 404 from the CDN and never reaches the app.

headers.//: Vite fingerprints these filenames, so a changed file always gets a new URL and an old URL can safely be cached forever.
index.html is the one file with a stable URL, so it must never be cached — otherwise a deploy ships new assets that nothing points at, and returning users stay on the old build indefinitely.
